import pathlib

    # Restore zeroed cells by extending the repeating row motif.
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    for r,row in enumerate(out):
        known=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v == 0:
                candidates=[k for k in known if abs(k-c)%4==0]
                if candidates: row[c]=row[min(candidates,key=lambda k:abs(k-c))]
    return out
')
